question: Where is Morgan Stanley investing in technology for its advisors?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley states its scale supports continued investment in future technology, including AI and digital tools, positioning it to lead as the future of wealth management takes shape.
items.quote: our scale supports continued investment in future technology, including AI and digital tools.

items.text: Morgan Stanley continues to invest in its technology stack, embracing AI tools to support its infrastructure, business growth and people, positioning to strengthen competitive moats across the integrated firm.
items.quote: We continue to invest across our technology stack, embracing AI tools to support our infrastructure, business growth and people.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's early AI use cases include LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform that matches workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitates engagement with financial advisors.
items.quote: LeadIQ, our AI-powered lead distribution platform, focusing on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with our financial advisors.

items.text: Morgan Stanley invests in ongoing technology including investments to support its advisors, a build-out of E*TRADE capabilities, and expansion of the workplace channel as engines for future growth.
items.quote: Ongoing investments in our world-class platform, including investments to support our advisors, a build-out of E*TRADE capabilities, and the expansion of our essential workplace channel, serve as an engine for future growth.

items.text: Morgan Stanley uses unique data (from $8.4 trillion of wealth management assets and nearly 21 million households) to equip its own tools that allow financial advisors to tailor advice to help clients achieve their goals.
items.quote: It gives us insights given our size and scale that allow our FAs to tailor advice and equip our own tools to deliver that advice to help clients achieve their goals.

items.text: Morgan Stanley invests in digital tools, digital enhancements and automation to help with the paper backlog associated with lending products.
items.quote: So digital tools, digital enhancements and using automation to be able to help with the paper backlog associated with some of the various lending products more broadly.

items.text: Morgan Stanley is investing in technology centered on building scale and dynamic risk management tools that are paying off in its equities franchise.
items.quote: Investments in technology centered on building scale and dynamic risk management tools are paying off.

items.text: Morgan Stanley cites world-class technology and world-class cyber defense combined with trusted advisers as part of its offering to wealth management and financial adviser clients.
items.quote: this is something we consider to be additive to what we have, which is world-class technology, world-class cyber defense and then the best trusted advisers sitting with the client.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it has been overweighted to AI from the early days in wealth with work done with OpenAI, and continues to invest in AI.
items.quote: We were, as you know, overweighted to AI from the early days in wealth with some of the work we did with OpenAI.

cells.reason: Multiple passages explicitly state where Morgan Stanley is investing in technology for its advisors, including AI tools, digital tools, data-driven advice tools, LeadIQ, and advisor support investments.
